offering_description.value: Itron sells smart metering, communications networks and software to electric, gas and water utilities and municipalities. It designs and manufactures meters and network devices, develops software for grid operations and meter data, and helps customers deploy and operate these systems.

primary_products.value: Smart meter communications modules; utility network equipment; electricity, gas and water meters; meter data management software; grid management and analytics software

primary_services.value: System deployment and integration; managed metering and network operations; software hosting; technical consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Investor-owned electric, gas and water utilities, and utility cooperatives; B2G: Municipal utilities, public power authorities and local governments

end_markets.value: Electric utilities; gas utilities; water utilities; municipal infrastructure

revenue_model.value: product sales: Meters, communications modules and network equipment; subscription: Cloud-hosted utility software and analytics; licensing or royalties: Utility software licenses; service fees: Managed network operations and technical consulting; project or contract: Metering system deployments and integration
revenue_model.category: product sales; subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Uses electronic and mechanical components to build meters and communications equipment for utilities; software / platform: Processes meter and grid data for utility operations teams; service provider: Integrates and operates metering and communications systems for utilities and municipalities
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Utility meters, communications networks, grid and meter data software, and managed operations

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving utility and municipal accounts through tenders and negotiated contracts; partners / resellers: Local resellers and systems integrators serving utilities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FCC and equivalent radio equipment rules, utility meter accuracy standards, and data protection requirements
